{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Build

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    tags:
      - "v*"
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - release/*
    types: [ opened, synchronize, reopened ]
jobs:
  # Prime a single LFS cache and expose the exact key for the matrix
  WarmLFS:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      lfs_key: ${{ steps.expose-key.outputs.lfs_key }}
    steps:
      - name: Git Config
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git config --global core.autocrlf false
          git config --global core.longpaths true

      - name: Git Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: recursive

      # Deterministic list of LFS object IDs, then compute a portable key:
      # - `git lfs ls-files -l` lists all tracked LFS objects with their SHA-256
      # - `awk '{print $1}'` extracts just the SHA field
      # - `sort` sorts in byte order (hex hashes sort the same everywhere)
      # This ensures the file content is identical regardless of OS or locale
      - name: Git Create LFS id list
        shell: bash
        run: git lfs ls-files -l | awk '{print $1}' | sort > .lfs-assets-id

      - name: Git Expose LFS cache key
        id: expose-key
        shell: bash
        env:
          LFS_KEY: lfs-${{ hashFiles('.lfs-assets-id') }}-v1
        run: echo "lfs_key=$LFS_KEY" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Git Setup LFS Cache
        uses: actions/cache@v6
        with:
          path: .git/lfs
          key: ${{ steps.expose-key.outputs.lfs_key }}

      - name: Git Pull LFS
        shell: bash
        run: git lfs pull

  Build:
    needs: WarmLFS
    strategy:
      matrix:
        isARM:
          - ${{ contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'arch:arm32') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'arch:arm64') }}
        options:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            framework: net11.0
            sdk: 11.0.x
            sdk-preview: true
            runtime: -x64
            codecov: false
          - os: macos-latest
            framework: net11.0
            sdk: 11.0.x
            sdk-preview: true
            runtime: -x64
            codecov: false
          - os: windows-latest
            framework: net11.0
            sdk: 11.0.x
            sdk-preview: true
            runtime: -x64
            codecov: false
          - os: buildjet-4vcpu-ubuntu-2204-arm
            framework: net11.0
            sdk: 11.0.x
            sdk-preview: true
            runtime: -x64
            codecov: false
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            framework: net10.0
            sdk: 10.0.x
            runtime: -x64
            codecov: false
          - os: macos-latest
            framework: net10.0
            sdk: 10.0.x
            runtime: -x64
            codecov: false
          - os: windows-latest
            framework: net10.0
            sdk: 10.0.x
            runtime: -x64
            codecov: true
        exclude:
          - isARM: false
            options:
              os: buildjet-4vcpu-ubuntu-2204-arm

    runs-on: ${{matrix.options.os}}
    timeout-minutes: 15

    steps:
      - name: Install libgdi+, which is required for tests running on ubuntu
        if: ${{ contains(matrix.options.os, 'ubuntu') }}
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get -y install libgdiplus libgif-dev libglib2.0-dev libcairo2-dev libtiff-dev libexif-dev

      - name: Git Config
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git config --global core.autocrlf false
          git config --global core.longpaths true

      - name: Git Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: recursive

      # Use the warmed key from WarmLFS. Do not recompute or recreate .lfs-assets-id here.
      - name: Git Setup LFS Cache
        uses: actions/cache@v6
        with:
          path: .git/lfs
          key: ${{ needs.WarmLFS.outputs.lfs_key }}

      - name: Git Pull LFS
        run: git lfs pull

      - name: NuGet Install
        uses: NuGet/setup-nuget@v4

      - name: NuGet Setup Cache
        uses: actions/cache@v6
        id: nuget-cache
        with:
          path: ~/.nuget
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-nuget-${{ hashFiles('**/*.csproj', '**/*.props', '**/*.targets') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-nuget-

      - name: DotNet Setup
        if: ${{ matrix.options.sdk-preview != true }}
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v6
        with:
          dotnet-version: |
            10.0.x

      - name: DotNet Setup Preview
        if: ${{ matrix.options.sdk-preview == true }}
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v6
        with:
          dotnet-version: |
            11.0.x

      - name: DotNet Build
        if: ${{ matrix.options.sdk-preview != true }}
        shell: pwsh
        run: ./ci-build.ps1 "${{matrix.options.framework}}"
        env:
          SIXLABORS_TESTING: True

      - name: DotNet Build Preview
        if: ${{ matrix.options.sdk-preview == true }}
        shell: pwsh
        run: ./ci-build.ps1 "${{matrix.options.framework}}"
        env:
          SIXLABORS_TESTING_PREVIEW: True

      - name: DotNet Test
        if: ${{ matrix.options.sdk-preview != true }}
        shell: pwsh
        run: ./ci-test.ps1 "${{matrix.options.os}}" "${{matrix.options.framework}}" "${{matrix.options.runtime}}" "${{matrix.options.codecov}}"
        env:
          SIXLABORS_TESTING: True
          XUNIT_PATH: .\tests\SixLabors.Fonts.Tests # Required for xunit

      - name: DotNet Test Preview
        if: ${{ matrix.options.sdk-preview == true }}
        shell: pwsh
        run: ./ci-test.ps1 "${{matrix.options.os}}" "${{matrix.options.framework}}" "${{matrix.options.runtime}}" "${{matrix.options.codecov}}"
        env:
          SIXLABORS_TESTING_PREVIEW: True
          XUNIT_PATH: .\tests\SixLabors.Fonts.Tests # Required for xunit

      - name: Export Failed Output
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        if: failure()
        with:
          name: actual_output_${{ runner.os }}_${{ matrix.options.framework }}${{ matrix.options.runtime }}.zip
          path: |
              tests/Images/ActualOutput/
              **/msbuild.binlog

      - name: Codecov Update
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v7
        if: matrix.options.codecov == true && startsWith(github.repository, 'SixLabors')
        with:
          flags: unittests
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}

  Publish:
    needs: [Build]

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    if: (github.event_name == 'push')

    steps:
      - name: Git Config
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git config --global core.autocrlf false
          git config --global core.longpaths true

      - name: Git Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: recursive

      - name: NuGet Install
        uses: NuGet/setup-nuget@v4

      - name: NuGet Setup Cache
        uses: actions/cache@v6
        id: nuget-cache
        with:
          path: ~/.nuget
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-nuget-${{ hashFiles('**/*.csproj', '**/*.props', '**/*.targets') }}
          restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-nuget-

      - name: DotNet Pack
        shell: pwsh
        run: ./ci-pack.ps1

      - name: Feedz Publish
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          dotnet nuget push .\artifacts\*.nupkg -k ${{secrets.FEEDZ_TOKEN}} -s https://f.feedz.io/sixlabors/sixlabors/nuget/index.json --skip-duplicate
          dotnet nuget push .\artifacts\*.snupkg -k ${{secrets.FEEDZ_TOKEN}} -s https://f.feedz.io/sixlabors/sixlabors/symbols --skip-duplicate

      - name: NuGet Publish
        if: ${{ startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/') }}
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          dotnet nuget push .\artifacts\*.nupkg -k ${{secrets.NUGET_TOKEN}} -s https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json --skip-duplicate
          dotnet nuget push .\artifacts\*.snupkg -k ${{secrets.NUGET_TOKEN}} -s https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json --skip-duplicate
",
  "rationale": "The workflow's Build job (matrix) currently has no explicit timeout. Historical CI runs show successful durations of 5-7 minutes. Adding a generous timeout of 15 minutes (3x observed maximum) bounds runaway executions while preserving all valid runs. This matches the P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT pattern, which reports VM time reductions of 12.9% (free) and 8.1% (paid) and is supported by an experiment showing 26.8% elapsed savings. The change is minimal, does not alter build/test coverage, and respects the contraindication that valid slow runs must not exceed the limit (15 minutes provides ample headroom).",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508", "pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"]
}
